name: start-former-employer-engagement
description: Builds a Former Employer Engagement Plan for work your old employer offers you as an outside provider, with scope and end date, who you report to and how requests reach you, your rate against your floor, the share of your income and time it takes and the limit you set, how the work differs from your old job, and questions on worker status and tax for a qualified adviser. Use for "run start-former-employer-engagement", "consulting for my former employer", "my old company wants me back as a contractor", "my only client is my old employer", "it feels like my old job without the benefits", "set boundaries with my first client", "contract with my previous employer", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
